expect.title: Why pixel art needs whole-number scaling
expect.author: Rin Okafor

summary: Pixel art looks crisp only when every source pixel becomes the same number of screen pixels.
Draw at a small base resolution and scale by a whole number.
Set image-rendering to pixelated so edges stay sharp.
decisions: lock our game at 320 by 180 pixels
